def _format_advisory_value(val: Any) -> str:

        return val.strip()

from typing import Any


def _format_advisory_value(val: Any) -> str:
    match val:
        case str():
            return val.strip()
        case list():
            return _format_advisory_list(val)
        case dict():
            return _format_advisory_dict(val)
        case _:
            return ""


def _format_advisory_list(val: list) -> str:
    items = []
    for item in val:
        res = _format_advisory_value(item)
        if res:
            items.append(f"- {res}")
    return "\n".join(items)


def _format_advisory_dict(val: dict) -> str:
    sub_parts = []
    for k, v in val.items():
        formatted = _format_advisory_value(v)
        if formatted:
            sub_parts.append(f"{k.capitalize()}:\n{formatted}")

class AdvisoryFallback:

        if res2:
            return res2
        return self._get_module_6a_content()

    def _get_module_6a_content(self) -> str | None:
        return None


def _advisory_to_text(advisory: Any) -> str | None:

            if text.strip():
                return text.strip()
        case dict() as adict:
            parts = _format_advisory_dict(adict)
            if parts:
                return parts
    return None


def _rationale_to_text(rationale: Any) -> str | None:
    if not isinstance(rationale, str):
        return None
    if not rationale.strip():
        return None
    return rationale.strip()

```

from typing import Any

def _get_events(scored: Any) -> list[Any]:
    if isinstance(scored, dict):
        return scored.get("events", [])
    return getattr(scored, "events", [])

def _collect_from_dict(event: dict, triggers: set[str]) -> None:
    for t in event.get("triggers", []):
        triggers.add(t)

def _collect_from_obj(event: Any, triggers: set[str]) -> None:
    if hasattr(event, "triggers"):
        for t in event.triggers:
            triggers.add(t)

def _collect_triggers_from_event(event: Any, triggers: set[str]) -> None:
    if isinstance(event, dict):
        _collect_from_dict(event, triggers)
    else:
        _collect_from_obj(event, triggers)

def _extract_trigger_labels(scored: Any) -> list[str]:
    triggers: set[str] = set()
    events = _get_events(scored)
    for event in events:
        _collect_triggers_from_event(event, triggers)
    return sorted(triggers)

def _synthesize_daily_payload(date_str: str, forecast_data: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "date": date_str,
        "summary": forecast_data.get("summary", ""),
        "confidence": forecast_data.get("confidence", 0.0),
    }

def _synthesize_and_save_daily_forecast(store: Any, date_str: str, forecast_data: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    if not date_str:
        return False
    if not forecast_data:
        return False
    payload = _synthesize_daily_payload(date_str, forecast_data)
    if hasattr(store, "save"):
        store.save(payload)
        return True
    return False

```
